items.prompt: A Soviet apartment in the late 1980s: a five-year-old boy seen from behind sits on the floor in front of an old television connected to a small home-made computer keyboard with a cassette recorder; the TV screen glows with a coloured border and blocky stripes. The parents' sofa in the shadows.

alt.ru: Советская квартира конца 1980-х: пятилетний мальчик со спины сидит на полу перед телевизором, подключённым к самодельному компьютеру с магнитофоном; экран светится цветной рамкой.
alt.en: A Soviet flat in the late 1980s: a five-year-old boy from behind on the floor before a TV hooked to a home-made computer and a tape recorder, the screen glowing with a coloured border.
alt.pt: Um apartamento soviético no fim dos anos 80: um rapaz de cinco anos, de costas, no chão diante de uma televisão ligada a um computador caseiro e a um gravador, o ecrã com uma moldura colorida.
alt.es: Un piso soviético a finales de los ochenta: un niño de cinco años de espaldas en el suelo ante un televisor conectado a un ordenador casero y una grabadora, la pantalla con un borde de color.
